value.rationale: Motivated by the published nonsharp cyclic seven-vertex upper bound and a numerical best near 0.3891, the combined statement gives the complete exact metric volume law of the canonical regular discrete cyclic family and the exact transverse seven-angle second-variation spectrum. This supplies an analytic near-sharp lower benchmark and proves a nontrivial local extremum without implying a global solution.
